_doc: Head marks (art bible 5.2 'Mảnh Gốc'): a Lattice Light polyomino drawn by code above a warden's head, still (no breathing, no lean). cells = [x, y] squares, y down from the top of the shape; cell_px = art px per square; head_px = art px from the feet to the top of the head in the idle clip; head_dx = art px from the frame centre to the head, in the sheet's own facing (mirrored with the sprite); gap_px = art px between the head and the shape. Units not listed have no mark. Measured from art_src/units/<id>/idle/0.png.
